attributes.name: David M Kerko
attributes.blurb: Consultant to KKR & Co. L.P. since 2015
attributes.summary: David Kerko is a member of the Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co. (KKR) technology industry team. Since joining KKR in 1998, Kerko has been actively involved in the investments in Borden, Toys' R Us, TASC and NXP (formerly Philips Semiconductor). Currently, he sits on the boards of Avago Technologies and Trident Microsystems. Prior to joining KKR, Kerko was with Gleacher NatWest Inc. where he was involved in merger and acquisition transactions and financing work.
